description: This file contains the implementation of the SerializerConfigurationAnalyzer class, which analyzes serializer configurations within the Orleans.Serialization namespace to identify potential issues with serializability of types used in grain interface methods. It includes methods for inspecting method signatures, return types, and parameter types, and reports types lacking serializers or copiers.

classes.name: SerializerConfigurationAnalyzer
classes.description: A static class that analyzes serializer configuration for potential issues related to types used in interface methods, focusing on the availability of serializers and copiers.

classes.name: SerializerConfigurationComplaint
classes.description: Represents a specific configuration issue for a type, including references to interface methods that involve the type and flags indicating serializer and copier availability.

methods.name: AnalyzeSerializerAvailability
methods.description: Analyzes interface methods from provided options to identify types that lack serializers or copiers, returning a dictionary of such types with associated complaints.
